description: This file defines a custom exception class HostedDomainException within the League\OAuth2\Client\Exception namespace, used for handling errors related to hosted domain mismatches in Google OAuth2 provider configuration.

classes.name: HostedDomainException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that the user's domain does not match the configured hosted domain for Google OAuth2 provider.

methods.name: notMatchingDomain
methods.description: Static method to create a new HostedDomainException with a message indicating the user is not part of the specified domain.
